BETA Close X Hikma Pharmaceuticals PLC has repurchased 623,461 of its ordinary shares on the London Stock Exchange between July 27 and July 31, 2026, as part of its $250 million share buyback program. The average price paid per share was approximately 1,595.40 pence. The company intends to cancel these repurchased shares, which will result in 210,142,206 ordinary shares outstanding. Disclaimer* Hikma Pharmaceuticals Plc 03 August 2026 HIKMA PHARMACEUTICALS PLC TRANSACTIONS IN OWN SHARES Hikma Pharmaceuticals PLC (LSE: HIK) (NasdaqDubai: HIK) (LEI: 549300BNS685UXH4JI75) (the '' Company '') announces that, during the period from 27 July 2026 to 31 July 2026 (inclusive) (the '' Disclosure Period ''), it purchased the following number of its ordinary shares of 10 pence each through J.P. Morgan Securities plc as part of the second tranche (which commenced on 27 May 2026) of its $250 million share repurchase programme announced on 26 February 2026 (the '' Buyback Programme ''). Date within Disclosure Period Trading Venue Aggregate number of ordinary shares repurchased Lowest price paid(pence) Highest price paid (pence) Volume-weighted average price (pence) 27 July 2026 XLON 121,731 1,573.0000 1,595.0000 1,584.5957 28 July 2026 XLON 116,910 1,579.0000 1,631.0000 1,614.3433 29 July 2026 XLON 114,647 1,612.0000 1,637.0000 1,626.7407 30 July 2026 XLON 118,447 1,588.0000 1,626.0000 1,599.3071 31 July 2026 XLON 115,891 1,587.0000 1,602.0000 1,594.6916 The Company intends to cancel the repurchased shares. Since the launch of the Buyback Programme on 26 February 2026, the Company has purchased a total of 11,744,247 ordinary shares at a total cost of £163,431,836.82. The Company holds 12,833,233 of its ordinary shares in treasury. Following the settlement of the above transactions and cancellation of the repurchased shares, the Company will have 210,142,206 ordinary shares in issue (excluding treasury shares) and the total number of voting rights in the Company will therefore be 210,142,206.
